description: D37 — 链接双车 - 第5课：后+双车三子协调——最强阵型

intro.popup_en: Connecting the Rooks, Lesson 5: The queen and two rooks are a powerful major-piece team. Qe2 controls the center, Re1 the e-file, and Rd1 the d-file; together their pressure multiplies.
intro.popup:
链接双车第5课
双车+后 = 重子协调的威力极强
Qe2控制中心，Re1控e列，Rd1控d列
三子配合，威力倍加！

outro.popup_en: Qe2, Re1, and Rd1 form a triangle of control. Each major piece has a distinct role, creating a powerful coordinated setup.
outro.popup:
总结：Qe2，R1，Rd1 = 后+双车三角控制
三个重子各司其职，这是很强的协调形态！

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the knight from the back rank.
O-O! White completes the three-step process and connects the rooks. The plan is Qe2 to coordinate them, then assign one rook to each central file.
moves.popup:
O-O！三步曲完成！双车连接！
计划：Qe2联结双车，Rd1+Re1分控两列

moves.popup_en: ...Nb6 moves Black's knight to an active square.
Qe2! The queen coordinates the rooks and becomes the command center of White's major-piece setup.
moves.popup:
Qe2！后联结双车
计划：Qe2是后+双车协调的指挥中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd5 develops Black's knight to another strong central square.
Rfe1! The rook from f1 occupies the e-file, which White now controls.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！车进e列！
激活：Rf1→e1——e列由白方掌控！

moves.popup_en: Rad1!! White completes the final formation: Qe2 coordinates Re1 on the e-file and Rd1 on the d-file. The queen and two rooks now control the center together.
moves.popup:
Rad1！！最终形态！
三角阵型完成：
后Qe2＋Re1（e列）＋Rd1（d列）
= 后+双车最强协调！
